observation.visible_scene: Top-down view of a play surface bordered by yellow paint smear (top-left) and blue paint smears (right and bottom-right). A light wooden board with a carved serpentine groove runs diagonally across the center; a blue plastic track fitted with orange rollers lies at the lower-left. Numerous colored cups/cylinders (orange, gray, red, teal, green, pink, blue, dark) are scattered around the board.
visible_changes: Frames 1-15 (t=0.000-0.560): a hand at the upper-right holds a dark brown cylinder at the top end of the wooden groove; the rest of the layout is static.

Between frame 15 and frame 16 (t=0.560-0.600) there is a discontinuity (an editing cut): the hand vanishes, a blue/purple cylinder now sits at the top of the groove, and a dark brown cylinder appears lying on the table to the left of the board.
Frames 16-31 (t=0.600-1.200): the post-cut arrangement remains static with no object motion.

From frame 32 (t=1.240) onward: a purple ball appears at the lower-left end of the blue roller track and translates steadily up-right along the rollers toward the wooden board, continuing through frame 41 (t=1.600).
outside_clip_unknowns: How the purple ball was introduced onto the track (no release or impact is shown).
The action or transition that produced the post-cut layout at frame 16.
The final resting position of the ball after frame 41.
uncertain_details: Whether the hand in frames 1-15 makes only tiny positioning adjustments or holds the cylinder still.
The exact cause of the jump between frame 15 and 16 is not visible; it is treated here as a cut rather than continuous motion.
